title: Gambling ads on social media reach more than twice as many men as women: study
summary: A Cambridge University study reveals that gambling advertisements on social media are disproportionately targeting men, reaching more than twice as many male users compared to female users. The research highlights significant gender imbalance in online gambling promotion.
problem_solved: Documents the gender disparity in gambling ad targeting on social media platforms.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about potential harms of gender-biased gambling advertising and its implications for public health and responsible gambling.
